thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem — we need a short consumer-facing summary + clear guidance on RCA sharing. Recurring pattern: DB connection flaps after scale-up. Who can draft the status page blurb?

maria-ux: I can draft the blurb. Want it brief, non-technical. Also suggest a 'what we're doing' bullet.

sam-sre: I'll add the incident timeline and mitigation steps. Also recommend we call out "no customer data exposed" explicitly.

tia-product: Important: align on when we publish the summary. Ops playbook suggests 2-4 hrs for initial status page update. Is that okay?

alex: 2-4 hrs fine. Let's aim for initial statusline within 90 mins and a follow-up postmortem summary within 24 hrs.

jordan-cs: Customer comms wants a short email-ready paragraph and a link to the status page. I'll prepare the email template.

maria-ux: Drafted blurb below — please react if ok or suggest edits:

```
Status: Partial degradation affecting inference on hosted API in US region. Impact: increased latency and some failed requests for affected tenants. Mitigation: traffic routed to fallback region and burst capacity enabled. Next update: we will post a detailed incident summary and action plan within 24 hours.
```

sam-sre: +1 for wording. Add sentence: "No customer data was exposed."

maria-ux: updated blurb with that sentence.

alex: For RCA sharing policy — proposal: public status page gets a non-technical summary and confirmed impact (duration, customers affected count if consenting). Full RCA (technical) is shared with customers on request and with enterprise customers automatically if SLA > threshold. Thoughts?

tia-product: I support that. Also add a redaction checklist for customer-facing RCAs (PII, exact IPs, internal hostnames).

sam-sre: I'll lead the redaction checklist doc. Action items: 1) maria-ux - status blurb (90 mins) 2) sam-sre - redaction checklist + incident timeline (24 hrs) 3) jordan-cs - customer email (90 mins) 4) tia-product - update policy doc for RCA sharing (3 business days).

ops-bot: Action items recorded: [maria-ux:status-blurb:deadline=1823457370] [sam-sre:redaction-doc:deadline=1823543189] [jordan-cs:customer-email:deadline=1823457370] [tia-product:policy-update:deadline=1823716389]

alex: Assigning ownership in jira now, will ping when tickets created. Also note recurring pattern: similar DB flaps seen in last 3 incidents — we need a separate remediation spike. sam — can you lead a deeper postmortem for the recurring failure?

sam-sre: Will do. Proposed timeline: investigate root cause + remediation plan in 10 business days, update weekly in eng-runtime channel.

jordan-cs: I'll prepare a customer FAQ snippet in case customers ask about recurring incidents.

maria-ux: final ask — can someone run the status blurb through legal/PR quick review? don't want wording that promises exact timelines.

alex: I'll ping legal and PR. Thanks everyone — let's reconvene after status blurb is live and confirm the follow-ups.
